notes.zh: 一次性大版本更新：更新电源板、灯板、主控和蓝牙模块。App 改用新的控制协议，支持新版智能遥控器和小遥控器配对；马达蓝牙名改为 SW-TM-XXXX。新增转向速度三档、电池电压与类型设置和低电量提示、无操作自动关机（默认关闭）、GPS 模组开机自检和 7 个卫星系统的卫星数、故障码与清除故障。转向更准更稳：转到指定角度不再冲过头、来回摆，回零和定锚时转向更稳；转向角度传感器不跟着转（例如磁铁松动）时自动停下并报故障。以后的马达更新都需要先装这个版本。
notes.en: One-time major update: new firmware for the power board, light board, main controller and Bluetooth module. The app uses the new control protocol and pairs the new smart remote and the mini remote; the motor's Bluetooth name becomes SW-TM-XXXX. New: three steering speeds, battery voltage and type settings with low-battery prompts, auto power-off when idle (off by default), GPS module self-check and satellites for 7 systems, fault codes with clearing. Steadier steering: no overshooting or swinging back and forth when turning to an angle, steadier homing and anchoring; the steering stops and reports a fault if its angle sensor does not follow (e.g. a loose magnet). Future motor updates require this version.

caution.zh: 升级约 15 分钟。期间不要按马达电源键、不要断开电池，手机放在马达旁边、不要离开升级页面。电源板控制整机供电，刷电源板时断电可能需要返厂维修。升级后请重新校准（指南针和转向）。智能遥控器要升级到新版本并重新配对后才能使用。
caution.en: The update takes about 15 minutes. Do not press the motor's power key or disconnect the battery; keep the phone next to the motor and stay on the update page. The power board supplies the whole motor: losing power while it is being updated may require a factory repair. Recalibrate afterwards (compass and steering). The smart remote works again only after it is updated and paired again.

notes.zh: 首个支持蓝牙在线升级的版本（测试版）。
notes.en: First version with Bluetooth online update (test build).

notes.zh: 配合马达整机 2.1.0 的新版遥控器：改由马达连接遥控器，在遥控器的配对页面配对；改用新的控制协议；电机设置分类，新增定位卫星、电机信息、故障码、转向速度、指示灯亮度；修复按住转向只动一下、按键偶尔没反应；马达复位后自动恢复连接。
notes.en: New remote firmware for motors updated to 2.1.0: the motor now connects to the remote, paired from the remote's pairing page; new control protocol; motor settings grouped, with satellites, motor info, fault codes, steering speed and light brightness; fixes steering moving only once while held and keys occasionally not responding; reconnects by itself after the motor restarts.

caution.zh: 只能配合已升级到 2.1.0 的马达使用，出厂版本的马达连不上。升级后在遥控器上打开配对页面，再按住马达灯板上的配对键，配对成功后才能使用。
caution.en: Works only with a motor updated to 2.1.0; motors with the original firmware can't connect. After the update, open the pairing page on the remote and hold the pairing key on the motor's light board until pairing succeeds.
